subject: physics

items.q: Which variable do you deliberately change?
items.why: You change the independent variable and measure the dependent variable, keeping others controlled.

items.correct: No — precise is repeatable; accurate is close to the true value.
items.why: You can be precise but inaccurate; repeats cut random error, not systematic error.

items.q: What should you do with a clear anomaly?
items.correct: Identify it and usually leave it out of the mean.
items.misconception: Always include it in the mean.
items.why: Anomalies are normally excluded; repeats and a mean improve reliability.
